name: cobblers

heightmap.revision_note: 2026-09-14: hand-carved revision (glacier, rift, lakes, rivers) saved under the same file name. The earlier file survives as land_8k_16_eroded.png.bak and its annotation as land_8k_16_eroded_annotated_outdated.png.

import.line_note: The same straight line as the first import (40/255 -> y40, 254/255 -> y200), extended down to full-scale 0 -> y10.093458. Land is unchanged; only sea columns below y40 deepen (docs/world-building/OCEAN.md). Approved 2026-09-13.

export.name: cobblers-10240

worldpainter_levels.note: WorldPainter world levels are whole numbers, so 10.093458 is written as image level -32.125 -> y10. Same line.

export.buffer_note: 1024 blocks of ocean inside the border plus a 256-block ring outside it. The ring is never reachable; it exists so chunks loaded within view distance of the border are already written and nothing generates outside the border.
export.seed_policy: Carried from the previous world's level.dat. Not committed: the public repo records only its sha256.

painted.maps: tools/paint_maps.py from data/regions.json paint_presets and data/landmarks.json water bodies
painted.note: Preview paint. See docs/world-building/REEXPORT.md for the export and its known issues.

export.worldpainter_project_note: Beside the heightmap under source_root. Painting starts from this file; its hash changes when it is saved again.
export.measured_ceiling_note: WorldPainter does not clamp at the top of the line: source values above 65406 reach y200.75 and round to y201 (0.88% of land). The design clamp stays 200.

verified.note: Re-measured on the 2026-09-14 hand-carved revision. The largest steps (3-4 blocks) are pixel-stepped terraces on the carved basin walls around Lake Tilpey and the glacier mouth.

rejected_artifacts.reason: sawtooth wraparound across the surface; 7.3% of horizontally adjacent pixels differed by >100 blocks; stored as 8-bit RGB with height only in the red channel
landmass clipped to 255 (mean 244, median 255); no land elevation data

notes: Grid origin confirmed as corner-at-origin, A1 at block 0,0, spanning 0-8191 on both axes.
bounds are derived from grid origin + cell_size * columns/rows and are not authored by hand.

import.low_in/high_in are fractions of full scale, so they survive a bit-depth change. Tooling multiplies by (2**bit_depth - 1) at read time. They were originally authored as 40 and 254 against an 8-bit file, which is where 0.156863 and 0.996078 come from.
import.low_out/high_out/water_level are absolute Minecraft Y values and never scale.

source_root is machine-specific and is not committed. On the authoring machine the heightmap and its provenance files sit directly in the Documents folder; set COBBLERS_SOURCE_ROOT or pass --source-root. See data/notes/source_tree.md.

The server world cobblers-10240 is exported from this heightmap by tools/reexport.py (2026-09-13). The previous world erosion-land-8k came from the rejected erosion_land_8k.png and was retired with its Distant Horizons LOD stores.
grid and bounds describe the landmass heightmap only; the exported world is larger (export.canvas) and the world border sits between the two (export.border).
